what_this_is: Buyer's-eye x402 settlement census as a time series: the same population paid once per round, the outcome recorded per host, the rounds diffed. Measurement, not certification.

ladder.rule: a host's series stays UNMEASURED until it has 30 paid observations; one observation per round
ladder.note: At one round a week the first host reaches n=30 after ~30 weeks. Nothing on this surface is a per-host verdict before then; the deltas are what a reader gets in the meantime.

cadence.population_rule: each round probes the hosts of the previous round (--hosts-from), so added/dropped are real changes

caveats: REFUSED is not proof of bad faith: a host may rate-limit, require an account, or have changed terms between the challenge and the retry.
One purchase per host, one moment. A single refusal is not a pattern; the second round next week is what makes it one.
Self excluded: our own hosts are never in the population; paying ourselves would be a self-settlement.
No host was contacted, ranked or recommended. A row says what happened; the chain says whether it happened.
